第1章(1)

“王爷吩咐过了，三少爷必须完成王爷所交代的任务。若是你合作些，那么在留种之后，老夫兴许会赏你一个痛快。”

昏暗的烛火下，原国宫中刑堂总管的声音再次在斐然的耳边响起，紧接着原本已渐渐静下来的刑堂上，各种吵杂或哭泣或恳求的女音也随之如潮浪般纷涌而来。

“三少爷……”

“奴家求求您了……”

一个个或美丽或妖娆的各色美女，又再次跪在斐然的脚前声声哀求啜泣，斐然却看也不看，从头到尾，他还是那么一句话。

“不必了，现下就杀了我吧。”

“老夫倒要瞧瞧，究竟是你的骨头硬，还是老夫的鞭子狠……”刑堂总管怒气攻心地抬起手，又是好几鞭朝他挥了过去。

随着斐冽逼宫的脚步逐渐加快，当再也等不下去的斐冽派人前来时，斐然已被困在宫中刑堂里受刑了三日，在这三个日夜里，斐然没有一次开口求饶，哪怕掌管刑堂的总管命令手下管事们大刑轮流齐上，这个年仅十四岁的三少爷，就是生生地硬挺着骨气，咬紧牙关任他们施为，宁死也不碰那些由斐冽送来的女人一下。

在这一日，身为斐冽左右手的杜衍仲来到了宫中刑堂，大步走到被连连下了三日大刑的斐然面前，神色不满地看着这个明明就只剩下一口气，却还是咬着牙始终不肯昏过去的斐然。

他问向一旁，“还是一个都没碰？”

“这小子矜持得跟个高贵的节妇似的。”刑堂总管厌恶地瞥了奄奄一息的斐然一眼，不明白这等美事送到眼前，那小子却嫌弃得跟什么一样，哪怕他们各路诱惑手段齐出，他始终就是不起半点反应，说什么也不交出那可笑的节操。

杜衍仲摆摆手，“算了，王爷也不是非他不可。”

刑堂总管听了后，随即将那些为斐然所准备的女人都给押了下去，而以为再次躲过一劫的斐然正想闭目休息一下时，冷不防地被杜衍仲一把给狠狠扯过发。

“听说三少爷你十分憎恨魂役？”那些个由斐冽所许出来的魂役，老早就想杀了这个倚仗着身分而不知死活的臭小子了，今日他之所以会来这，可全拜了这小子之赐。

斐然沙哑地开口，“那又如何？”

“瞧瞧这是什么？”收了无数金银受托来此的他，自怀中取出一只信封，再小心地取出其中一张由斐冽亲自赏下的纸张。

斐然似是明白了什么，当下如临大敌般地握紧了拳心，恶狠狠地瞪向他。

“既然你视魂役于无物，又总是如此瞧不起我等……那就让你许个愿吧。”

果然是怕什么来什么，杜衍仲一开口就让他的眉心更加深皱了几分。

“休想。”一想到要让他在那危害世人、祸乱天下的魂纸上许愿，斐然毫不考虑就拒绝。

“该让你许什么愿好呢……”杜衍仲根本就不在意他的拒绝，只是一手抚着下巴，状似忙碌地辗想，“至于代价嘛，又该让你付出什么才好？”

宫中刑堂总管嗤声笑了笑，“何必那么麻烦，咱们随意替他写写不就成了？”

“三少爷，您是打算认分点自个儿写上呢，还是由我等来代劳？要知道，若是让我等动手，到时可就不保证我们会许下什么愿望了，哪，你说该是涂炭生灵好呢，还是再许出个混世杀神来好？”杜衍仲摇头晃脑地说着，看似因选择过多而好不烦恼。

听着他和斐冽一般不在乎人命的建议，斐然隐忍地深吸了几口气，不得不在这当下选择拉下脸来低头。

“我写。”

“这才上道嘛。”杜衍仲笑笑地命人解下他右手的锁铐，“来。”

斐然动了动因长时间被高高系于墙上的右手一会儿，待到指尖的麻木感总算消减些了后，方抬起手，就被杜衍仲以刀割破了他右手的食指，然后强行放在那张由两名刑堂管事所摊开的魂纸上。

乍一看与普通纸张没什么差别的魂纸，在斐然的血滴落至纸面上时，吸入新鲜血液的纸张，就像只贪婪的兽，正渴望着更多的由野心和愿望所带来的血腥，素净的纸面缓缓泛起一道道宛如琉璃般的彩光，似是在尽其可能般地勾撩着人们的心神。

斐然只稍稍迟疑了一会儿，便在杜衍仲催赶似的目光下扬指写下他的心愿，接着马上就被杜衍仲给拍开了他的指尖。

“行善助人，造福人间？”杜衍仲不满地皱着眉，“这是哪门子的鬼心愿？”谁人没有私心，谁人又不在乎功名利禄？天底下有哪个得到魂纸的人会许这等无私又愚蠢的愿望？

“我乐意。”

“至于代价嘛，小子，你能付出什么代价？”杜衍仲压下满心的不快，不受挫地继续开口，“听说王爷的亲卫代王爷许愿时，有人给了一双眼，有人则成了哑子，有人甚至连一家老小的性命都奉上了……”

斐然不言不语地任由他与刑堂上的人们恶意嘲弄，也丝毫不在意将会被迫付出什么代价，生来就倔强的性子，让他就像只即使被狠狠压着头也不肯喝水的牛，哪怕来者再硬再狠，他就是无动无衷。

岂知他这副倔着性子的模样却勾动了杜衍仲的心思，他转眼想了想，放软了音调，格外和蔼可亲地问。

“听这些刑堂管事说，你拒绝为王爷留下血脉的原因，是因你嫌弃？”普天之下敢如此堂而皇之鄙视斐冽的人，恐怕也就唯有这不知天高地厚，且丝毫不感激生身之恩的臭小子了。

“是嫌脏。”斐然冷冷轻哼，转首不屑地看着他们这一票属于斐冽麾下的走狗，“身上流着那疯子肮脏污秽的血统，想想就够令人作呕了，我巴不得让那疯子的血脉就断在我这一代。”

“哟，是吗？”杜衍仲不以为意地挑着眉，“既然你不打算留下血脉，那不如就让我成全你这愿望吧。”

成全他的愿望？

斐然防备地看着他带着不怀好意的凉笑，一把抓来他犹流着血的手，捏起他的指尖，恶意地在魂纸上替他书上两字作为代价。

“你……”指尖犹被按在魂纸上的斐然怔愣不过片刻，立即凶狠地眯细了眼。

杜衍仲轻拍着他的面颊，“反正你不是不在乎吗？我这是成全你。”

一阵心情激越过后，斐然登时冷静了下来，在杜衍仲两眼直盯着他又开始奚落起他时，犹搁放在魂纸上的指尖，不着痕迹地动了动……

眼看着许下愿望也付出代价后的魂纸，在不久过后便因许愿完成而化为一团紫色的艳火燃烧了起来，嗅着纸张燃烧后阵阵难以言喻的惑人气息，杜衍仲一把勾起斐然的下巴，使劲地将心不在焉也不知神游至何处的他给捏回神。

“不过你似乎忘了，你也不过是王爷子嗣中的其一罢了，就算你不肯生又如何？总还是有人能生的。”

“什么意思？”斐然吃痛地想躲开他的手劲，怎么也想不出眼下府中除了他外，斐冽还能有什么别的选择。

“就例如你视之如珠如宝的四小姐。”

斐然顿时惊恐地瞪大了双眼，“你们想做什么？”

“三少爷还不知道吗？王爷已将高贵的四小姐赏给我们了。”杜衍仲松开了手，自顾自地整理好衣袖，朝一旁早就等不及的同僚示意，边说边往刑堂的大门走去，“您就在这慢慢享受宫中的大刑吧，我们可要回王府一尝皇室贵女是什么滋味！”

Chapter 1(1)

"The prince has given instructions. The third young master must complete the tasks assigned by the prince. If you cooperate more, then after saving the seeds, I may give you a good reward."

Under the dim candlelight, the voice of the supervisor of the torture hall in the Yuanguo Palace rang in Fei Ran's ears again, and then in the torture hall that had gradually quieted down, all kinds of noisy, crying or pleading female voices also came in like a wave.

"Third Young Master..."

"I beg you, slave..."

All the beauties, either beautiful or enchanting, knelt at Feiran's feet again, begging and sobbing, but Feiran didn't even look at her. From the beginning to the end, he kept saying the same thing.

"No need, just kill me now."

"I would like to see whether it is your bones that are stronger or my whip that is stronger..." The head of the execution hall raised his hand angrily and swung the whip at him several times.

As Fei Lie's march to the palace gradually accelerated, when Fei Lie, who could no longer wait any longer, sent someone to come, Fei Ran had been trapped in the torture hall of the palace for three days. During these three days and nights, Fei Ran never once asked for mercy, even if he was in charge of the palace.The chief steward of the execution hall ordered his subordinates to take turns to execute the executions. The third young master, who was only fourteen years old, just stood up and gritted his teeth and let them do what they did. He would rather die than touch the women sent by Fei Lie.

On this day, Du Yanzhong, who was Fei Lie's right-hand man, came to the execution hall in the palace and strode up to Fei Ran, who was being tortured for three consecutive days. He looked dissatisfied at Fei Ran, who had only one breath left but still gritted his teeth and refused to faint.

He asked to the side, "Still haven't touched any?"

"This kid is as reserved as a noble and chaste woman." The head of the execution hall glanced at the dying Fei Ran with disgust. He didn't understand how much he disliked such a beautiful thing before his eyes. Even if they tried all kinds of temptations, he still couldn't react at all, and he wouldn't give up that ridiculous moral integrity.

Du Yanzhong waved his hand, "Forget it, the prince doesn't have to do it."

After hearing this, the supervisor of the execution hall immediately took all the women prepared for Feiran into custody. When Feiran, who thought he had escaped danger again, was about to close his eyes and take a rest, his hair was violently pulled by Du Yanzhong unexpectedly.

"I heard that Third Young Master, you hate soul service very much?" Those soul servants promised by Fei Lie have long wanted to kill this brat who relies on his status to live and die. The reason why he is here today is all thanks to this brat.

Fei Ran said hoarsely, "So what?"

"Look what this is?" He, who had received countless gold and silver and was entrusted to come here, took out an envelope from his arms, and then carefully took out a piece of paper that Fei Lie personally rewarded.

Feiran seemed to understand something, and immediately he clenched his fists as if facing a formidable enemy and glared at him viciously.

"Since you regard your soul as nothing, and always look down on us so much... then let me make a wish."

Sure enough, he was afraid of what would happen. As soon as Du Yanzhong opened his mouth, his eyebrows furrowed even deeper.

"Don't even think about it." When he thought about asking him to make a wish on the soul paper that would endanger the world and bring disaster to the world, Feiran refused without thinking.

"What wish should I ask you to make..." Du Yanzhong didn't care about his rejection at all. He just stroked his chin with one hand and seemed to be busy thinking, "As for the price, what should I ask you to pay?"

The head of the execution hall in the palace sneered, "Why go to all the trouble? Can't we just write it for him at will?"

"Third Young Master, do you plan to write down the points yourself, or do we do it for you? You know, if you let me do it, there is no guarantee what wish we will make. Well, do you think it is better to destroy the living beings, or to make a wish to create a murderous god?" Du Yanzhong shook his head and said, seemingly troubled by too many choices.

Listening to his suggestion that he and Fei Lie generally didn't care about human life, Fei Ran took a few deep breaths and had no choice but to lower his face and lower his head at this moment.

"I write."

"This is the beginning." Du Yanzhong smiled and ordered someone to remove the cuffs on his right hand, "Come on."

Feiran moved his right hand, which had been tied high to the wall for a long time. When the numbness in his fingertips finally subsided, he raised his hand, and Du Yanzhong cut the index finger of his right hand with a knife, and then forcibly placed it on the soul paper spread out by two execution hall stewards.

At first glance, the soul paper looks no different from ordinary paper. When the brilliant blood drops fall on the paper, the paper that absorbs the fresh blood is like a greedy beast, craving for more blood brought by ambition and desire. The plain paper surface slowly glows with colored lights like glass, seeming to seduce people's minds as much as possible.

Feiran only hesitated for a moment, then raised his finger to write down his wish under Du Yanzhong's urging eyes, and then Du Yanzhong immediately slapped his fingertip away.

"Do good, help others, and benefit the world?" Du Yanzhong frowned dissatisfied, "What kind of ghost wish is this?" Who has no selfish motives, and who doesn't care about fame and fortune?Who in the world who has obtained the soul paper would make such a selfless and stupid wish?

"I'd love to."

"As for the price, boy, what price can you pay?" Du Yanzhong suppressed his unhappiness and continued to speak without frustration, "I heard that when the prince's bodyguard made a wish on his behalf, some gave him a pair of eyes, some became mute, and some even sacrificed the lives of the whole family..."

Fei Ran silently allowed himself and the people in the torture hall to mock him maliciously, and did not care at all what price he would be forced to pay. His naturally stubborn temper made him like a cow that refused to drink water even if its head was pressed hard. No matter how hard and cruel the attackers were, he would remain indifferent.

Unexpectedly, his stubborn look aroused Du Yanzhong's thoughts. He thought for a moment, softened his tone, and asked in an especially amiable manner.

"I heard from these execution hall managers that the reason why you refused to leave a bloodline for the prince was because you disliked him?" The only person in the world who dares to despise Fei Lie so openly is probably this brat who doesn't know the bounds of heaven and earth and is not grateful at all for his life.

"It's because they're dirty." Fei Ran snorted coldly and turned to look at them, the lackeys who belonged to Fei Lie, with disdain. "It's disgusting to think about the dirty and filthy blood of that madman flowing through them. I wish that the blood of that madman would be cut off in my generation."

"Oh, really?" Du Yanzhong raised his eyebrows indifferently, "Since you don't plan to leave your bloodline, why not let me fulfill your wish."

Fulfill his wish?

Fei Ran looked at him defensively with a malicious smile, grabbed his bleeding hand, pinched his fingertips, and maliciously wrote two words for him on the soul paper as a price.

"You..." Feiran, whose fingertips were still pressed on the soul paper, was stunned for only a moment, and immediately narrowed his eyes fiercely.

Du Yanzhong patted his cheek, "Don't you care anyway? I'm here to help you."

After a moment of excitement, Fei Ran calmed down immediately. When Du Yanzhong stared at him and began to ridicule him, the fingertips resting on the soul paper moved without leaving a trace...

Seeing the soul paper that had made the wish and paid the price, it turned into a purple fire and burned shortly after the wish was fulfilled. Smelling the indescribable and alluring smell after the paper burned, Du Yanzhong raised Fei Li's chin and pinched him back to his senses after he was absent-minded and didn't know where he was wandering.

"But you seem to have forgotten that you are just one of Mr. Wang's children. So what if you don't want to give birth? There will always be someone who can give birth."

"What do you mean?" Fei Ran tried to dodge his hand in pain, but he couldn't think of any other choice for Fei Lie in the house besides him.

"Just like the fourth lady who you regard as a jewel."

Feiran's eyes widened in horror, "What do you want to do?"

"Don't you know, Third Young Master? Your Majesty has rewarded us with the noble Fourth Young Lady." Du Yanzhong let go of his hand, straightened his sleeves, and motioned to his colleagues who couldn't wait for a long time. He walked to the door of the execution hall while saying, "You can enjoy the punishment in the palace slowly here. We have to go back to the palace to taste what it is like to be a royal daughter!"
